eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 50 · Data Types, Strings, and Dates

code:
SELECT CAST(ListPrice AS VARCHAR(20)) AS PriceAsText
FROM Production.Product;
caption: value AS newType — portable across most database systems.

code:
SELECT OrderDate,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), OrderDate, 101) AS USFormat,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), OrderDate, 103) AS UKFormat
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader;
caption: newType, value — reversed order — plus an optional style code CAST doesn't have.
Non-convertible values error out — validate source data first.
